## Complete Interaction Tag / Hover Detection Architecture

### 1. MousePointer — Single Raycast Source

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/MousePointer.cs`

- Runs at execution order **-90** (before most consumers).
- Every frame performs **exactly one** `Physics.Raycast` against a combined `_worldMask` layer mask.
- Caches: `ScreenPosition`, `WorldRay`, `HasHit`, `Hit`, `WorldPoint`, `HoverCollider`, `HoverObject`.
- Fires `OnHoverChanged` event when hovered GameObject changes.
- Public helper: `HoverOnLayers(LayerMask mask)`.
- This eliminates duplicate raycasts across the codebase — one source of truth.

### 2. PlayerMouseAimer — Derives All Hover Targets From MousePointer

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/PlayerMouseAimer.cs`

- Has a `[RequireComponent(typeof(SolarpunkCharacterController))]`.
- Reads `MousePointer.Instance.HoverObject` and `MousePointer.Instance.WorldPoint` each frame.
- **No longer casts its own rays** — it derives every hovered target from the single shared hit.
- **Detection logic** — it calls `GetComponentInParent<T>()` on the hovered GameObject for each concern:

| Public Property | Component Checked | Range Gate |
|---|---|---|
| `HoveredResource` | `Find<ResourceNode>(hovered)` | `_interactionRange` (3f) |
| `HoveredPickup` | `Find<WorldItemPickup>(hovered)` | `_interactionRange` (3f) |
| `HoveredKeyPickup` | `Find<WorldItem>(hovered)` + `item.Item != null && !item.Item.AutoCollects` | `_interactionRange` (3f) |
| `HoveredAnchor` | `Find<RopeAnchor>(hovered)` | None (controller gates) |
| `HoveredPullable` | `Find<RopePullable>(hovered)` | None (controller gates) |
| `MeleeResource` / `SwingAnimIndex` | `Find<ResourceNode>(hovered)` or `Find<HittableSurface>(hovered)` | `_meleeRange` (2.5f) |
| **`HoveredInteractable`** | **`GetComponentInParent<IInteractionPromptProvider>(hovered)`** + rope fallback | `_interactionRange` (3f) then rope targets |

- **`HoveredInteractable` detection** (lines 189-204):
  1. First tries `GetComponentInParent<IInteractionPromptProvider>()` on the hovered object — **only if within `_interactionRange`** (3m).
  2. Falls back to checking if `HoveredAnchor` or `HoveredPullable` implements `IInteractionPromptProvider` (no range gate — rope controller owns range).

- **No tag or layer filtering** on the aimer side — it relies entirely on finding components on the hovered GameObject (via `GetComponentInParent<T>` in the private `Find<T>()` helper). The layer mask is owned by `MousePointer`.

### 3. WorldInteractTag — World-Space Offset Anchor

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WorldInteractTag.cs`

- Simple `MonoBehaviour` with a single `[SerializeField] private Vector3 _worldOffset = new(0f, 1.5f, 0f)`.
- Marked with: *"Drop this on any interactable that implements `IInteractionPromptProvider` to control where the hover tag appears relative to the object's origin."*
- **Currently unused** by `WorldInteractTagPresenter` (the presenter reads `IInteractionPromptProvider` and positions the panel at the mouse cursor, not the world anchor). It's a *world* offset component that seems designed for a future world-space tag rather than the current screen-space cursor-following tag.

### 4. IInteractionPromptProvider & InteractionPrompt — The Interface

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/InteractionPrompt.cs`

**`InteractionPrompt`** (readonly struct):
```csharp
public readonly struct InteractionPrompt
{
    public readonly string Key;     // "E", "Q", …
    public readonly string Verb;    // "Pick Up", "Inspect", "Talk", "Grapple"
    public readonly string Label;   // optional target name
    public readonly Transform Anchor;
    public bool IsValid => Anchor != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Verb);
    public string Display => ... // e.g. "[E]  Pick Up Wrench" or "[Q]  Grapple"
}
```

**`IInteractionPromptProvider`** (interface):
```csharp
public interface IInteractionPromptProvider
{
    bool TryGetPrompt(out InteractionPrompt prompt);
}
```

**Implementations found:**
| Class | File | Prompt |
|---|---|---|
| `WorldItem` | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/World/WorldItem.cs` | `[E] Pick Up {displayName}` (only if `!AutoCollects`) |
| `RopeAnchor` | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopeAnchor.cs` | `[Q] Grapple` |
| `RopePullable` | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopePullable.cs` | `[Q] Grapple` |

### 5. WorldInteractTagPresenter — Bridge from Aimer to UI

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WorldInteractTagPresenter.cs`

- `LateUpdate` reads `PlayerMouseAimer.HoveredInteractable`.
- Calls `hovered.TryGetPrompt(out InteractionPrompt prompt)`.
- If valid, calls `_tagPanel.Show(prompt.Display)`.
- If null/invalid, calls `_tagPanel.HideTag()`.
- Includes a Unity fake-null guard: `if (hovered is UnityEngine.Object obj && obj == null) hovered = null`.

### 6. UI Hierarchy

**`UIPanelId`** (enum in `Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIPanel.cs`):
```csharp
None = 0, Hud, Inventory, Dialogue, Pause, InteractTag
```

**`IUIPanel`** (interface in same file):
```csharp
UIPanelId PanelId { get; }
bool IsVisible { get; }
void Show();
void Hide();
```

**`UIPanel`** (abstract base, same file):
- `MonoBehaviour` implementing `IUIPanel`.
- GameObject-level show/hide (`SetActive(true/false)`).
- Virtual `Show()` / `Hide()` with `OnShow()` / `OnHide()` hooks.

**`UIToolkitPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIToolkitPanel.cs`):
- Extends `UIPanel`.
- Wraps a `UIDocument` component.
- Show/Hide toggle `Root.style.display` instead of the GameObject — keeps the UIDocument alive to avoid rebuild/rebind.
- Abstract `Bind(VisualElement root)` — retried from `Update` until the visual tree is available.
- `_startVisible` field (true for always-present HUD, false for pop-ups like the hover tag).
- `OnBound()` virtual for initial data refresh.

**`InteractTagPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Screens/InteractTag/InteractTagPanel.cs`):
- Extends `UIToolkitPanel` with `UIPanelId.InteractTag`.
- Binds `_root` (a `VisualElement` with `#InteractTagRoot`) and `_label` (`#InteractTagLabel`).
- **Follows mouse cursor** in `LateUpdate` — converts `Input.mousePosition` to UI Toolkit panel coordinates.
- `Show(string text)` sets label text + makes root visible.
- `HideTag()` hides root.

**`UIManager`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIManager.cs`):
- Singleton (`Instance`), execution order **-100**.
- Serialized list of `UIPanel` references registered into a `Dictionary<UIPanelId, IUIPanel>`.
- Inbound signals: `SignalShow(id)`, `SignalHide(id)`, `SignalToggle(id)` — routes to the matching panel.
- Outbound events: `OnPanelShown`, `OnPanelHidden`.

### Architecture Data Flow Summary

```
MousePointer (single raycast, Update -90)
    ↓ HoverObject, WorldPoint
PlayerMouseAimer (Update, no own raycasts)
    ↓ GetComponentInParent<IInteractionPromptProvider>()
    ↓ HoveredInteractable (public property)
WorldInteractTagPresenter (LateUpdate)
    ↓ TryGetPrompt() → InteractionPrompt.Display
InteractTagPanel.Show(text) or .HideTag()
    ↓ (cursor-following in its own LateUpdate)
Screen-space label "[E] Pick Up Wrench" or "[Q] Grapple"
```

### Key Design Decisions
1. **Single raycast per frame** — `MousePointer` does one cast, everyone reads it.
2. **Component-based detection** — No tags or layers used for interactable identification; uses `GetComponentInParent<IInteractionPromptProvider>()`.
3. **Range-gating** — Only generic interactions (`_interactionRange = 3m`) are range-gated; grapple targets bypass the range gate (controller owns it).
4. **Generic HUD** — The HUD/panel knows nothing about concrete interactable types; it renders whatever `IInteractionPromptProvider.TryGetPrompt()` returns.
5. **UIDocument kept alive** — `UIToolkitPanel` toggles `display: flex/none` rather than deactivating the GameObject, preventing UIDocument rebuilds.
6. **WorldInteractTag offset component exists but is currently unused** by the screen-space cursor-following tag. It appears designed for future world-space tag anchoring.

## Complete Interaction Tag / Hover Detection Architecture

### 1. MousePointer — Single Raycast Source

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/MousePointer.cs`

- Runs at execution order **-90** (before most consumers).
- Every frame performs **exactly one** `Physics.Raycast` against a combined `_worldMask` layer mask.
- Caches: `ScreenPosition`, `WorldRay`, `HasHit`, `Hit`, `WorldPoint`, `HoverCollider`, `HoverObject`.
- Fires `OnHoverChanged` event when hovered GameObject changes.
- Public helper: `HoverOnLayers(LayerMask mask)`.
- This eliminates duplicate raycasts across the codebase — one source of truth.

### 2. PlayerMouseAimer — Derives All Hover Targets From MousePointer

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/PlayerMouseAimer.cs`

- Has a `[RequireComponent(typeof(SolarpunkCharacterController))]`.
- Reads `MousePointer.Instance.HoverObject` and `MousePointer.Instance.WorldPoint` each frame.
- **No longer casts its own rays** — it derives every hovered target from the single shared hit.
- **Detection logic** — it calls `GetComponentInParent<T>()` on the hovered GameObject for each concern:

| Public Property | Component Checked | Range Gate |
|---|---|---|
| `HoveredResource` | `Find<ResourceNode>(hovered)` | `_interactionRange` (3f) |
| `HoveredPickup` | `Find<WorldItemPickup>(hovered)` | `_interactionRange` (3f) |
| `HoveredKeyPickup` | `Find<WorldItem>(hovered)` + `item.Item != null && !item.Item.AutoCollects` | `_interactionRange` (3f) |
| `HoveredAnchor` | `Find<RopeAnchor>(hovered)` | None (controller gates) |
| `HoveredPullable` | `Find<RopePullable>(hovered)` | None (controller gates) |
| `MeleeResource` / `SwingAnimIndex` | `Find<ResourceNode>(hovered)` or `Find<HittableSurface>(hovered)` | `_meleeRange` (2.5f) |
| **`HoveredInteractable`** | **`GetComponentInParent<IInteractionPromptProvider>(hovered)`** + rope fallback | `_interactionRange` (3f) then rope targets |

- **`HoveredInteractable` detection** (lines 189-204):
  1. First tries `GetComponentInParent<IInteractionPromptProvider>()` on the hovered object — **only if within `_interactionRange`** (3m).
  2. Falls back to checking if `HoveredAnchor` or `HoveredPullable` implements `IInteractionPromptProvider` (no range gate — rope controller owns range).

- **No tag or layer filtering** on the aimer side — it relies entirely on finding components on the hovered GameObject (via `GetComponentInParent<T>` in the private `Find<T>()` helper). The layer mask is owned by `MousePointer`.

### 3. WorldInteractTag — World-Space Offset Anchor

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WorldInteractTag.cs`

- Simple `MonoBehaviour` with a single `[SerializeField] private Vector3 _worldOffset = new(0f, 1.5f, 0f)`.
- Marked with: *"Drop this on any interactable that implements `IInteractionPromptProvider` to control where the hover tag appears relative to the object's origin."*
- **Currently unused** by `WorldInteractTagPresenter` (the presenter reads `IInteractionPromptProvider` and positions the panel at the mouse cursor, not the world anchor). It's a *world* offset component that seems designed for a future world-space tag rather than the current screen-space cursor-following tag.

### 4. IInteractionPromptProvider & InteractionPrompt — The Interface

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/InteractionPrompt.cs`

**`InteractionPrompt`** (readonly struct):
```csharp
public readonly struct InteractionPrompt
{
    public readonly string Key;     // "E", "Q", …
    public readonly string Verb;    // "Pick Up", "Inspect", "Talk", "Grapple"
    public readonly string Label;   // optional target name
    public readonly Transform Anchor;
    public bool IsValid => Anchor != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Verb);
    public string Display => ... // e.g. "[E]  Pick Up Wrench" or "[Q]  Grapple"
}
```

**`IInteractionPromptProvider`** (interface):
```csharp
public interface IInteractionPromptProvider
{
    bool TryGetPrompt(out InteractionPrompt prompt);
}
```

**Implementations found:**
| Class | File | Prompt |
|---|---|---|
| `WorldItem` | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/World/WorldItem.cs` | `[E] Pick Up {displayName}` (only if `!AutoCollects`) |
| `RopeAnchor` | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopeAnchor.cs` | `[Q] Grapple` |
| `RopePullable` | `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/RopePullable.cs` | `[Q] Grapple` |

### 5. WorldInteractTagPresenter — Bridge from Aimer to UI

**File:** `Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/WorldInteractTagPresenter.cs`

- `LateUpdate` reads `PlayerMouseAimer.HoveredInteractable`.
- Calls `hovered.TryGetPrompt(out InteractionPrompt prompt)`.
- If valid, calls `_tagPanel.Show(prompt.Display)`.
- If null/invalid, calls `_tagPanel.HideTag()`.
- Includes a Unity fake-null guard: `if (hovered is UnityEngine.Object obj && obj == null) hovered = null`.

### 6. UI Hierarchy

**`UIPanelId`** (enum in `Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIPanel.cs`):
```csharp
None = 0, Hud, Inventory, Dialogue, Pause, InteractTag
```

**`IUIPanel`** (interface in same file):
```csharp
UIPanelId PanelId { get; }
bool IsVisible { get; }
void Show();
void Hide();
```

**`UIPanel`** (abstract base, same file):
- `MonoBehaviour` implementing `IUIPanel`.
- GameObject-level show/hide (`SetActive(true/false)`).
- Virtual `Show()` / `Hide()` with `OnShow()` / `OnHide()` hooks.

**`UIToolkitPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIToolkitPanel.cs`):
- Extends `UIPanel`.
- Wraps a `UIDocument` component.
- Show/Hide toggle `Root.style.display` instead of the GameObject — keeps the UIDocument alive to avoid rebuild/rebind.
- Abstract `Bind(VisualElement root)` — retried from `Update` until the visual tree is available.
- `_startVisible` field (true for always-present HUD, false for pop-ups like the hover tag).
- `OnBound()` virtual for initial data refresh.

**`InteractTagPanel`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Screens/InteractTag/InteractTagPanel.cs`):
- Extends `UIToolkitPanel` with `UIPanelId.InteractTag`.
- Binds `_root` (a `VisualElement` with `#InteractTagRoot`) and `_label` (`#InteractTagLabel`).
- **Follows mouse cursor** in `LateUpdate` — converts `Input.mousePosition` to UI Toolkit panel coordinates.
- `Show(string text)` sets label text + makes root visible.
- `HideTag()` hides root.

**`UIManager`** (`Assets/Flynn/UI/Core/UIManager.cs`):
- Singleton (`Instance`), execution order **-100**.
- Serialized list of `UIPanel` references registered into a `Dictionary<UIPanelId, IUIPanel>`.
- Inbound signals: `SignalShow(id)`, `SignalHide(id)`, `SignalToggle(id)` — routes to the matching panel.
- Outbound events: `OnPanelShown`, `OnPanelHidden`.

```
MousePointer (single raycast, Update -90)
